summary: AI engineer with four years shipping production LLM systems end-to-end — tool-calling agents, RAG and document-processing pipelines over structured and unstructured data, prompt and output-guardrail design, evaluation, and monitoring. I've built and run LLM features in a regulated healthcare setting and own the full loop from architecture to production in small, product-focused teams. Strong Python plus TypeScript/Node.js, LangChain/LangGraph, PostgreSQL, Redis, and AWS, with a focus on reliability, latency, and cost.

bullets: Own the full AI feature lifecycle in production: architecture, retrieval and prompt design, output validation, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
Built an LLM-powered clinical decision-support agent that retrieves patient history to generate medication recommendations and AI-assisted diagnostic guidance for clinicians.
Designed the retrieval, prompt, and output-guardrail layers for a production medical chatbot, improving the reliability of generated recommendations and reducing hallucination risk.

Built the retrieval and data layer with Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Redis; caching and optimized query patterns improved data-access performance by **30%** for high-frequency inference calls (latency and cost).
Built an agentic n8n pipeline that orchestrates multi-step LLM workflows — ingesting job descriptions and generating tailored content — saving **90%+** of manual time.
Built an AI-driven wellness platform with LangChain and RAG pipelines, normalizing third-party health data and retrieving relevant context to generate personalized user plans.
Developed an AI Virtual Trainer agent with agentic reasoning and personalization, increasing user engagement by **40%**; owned design, development, and deployment.

Built SmartMedHx, an AI-assisted patient-intake system (Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL) that applies LLM extraction to turn unstructured clinical data into structured records and automate manual workflows.
Engineered a GPT-Canvas-style streaming LLM renderer using token streaming and incremental rendering, achieving **98%** rendering accuracy.
Designed and deployed an AI coaching assistant serving **1,000+ professionals**.
Built Refill Arena from zero to **$1M+ revenue**, owning backend infrastructure, data models, and scalable APIs across **3,200+ brands** and **190+ countries**.
Designed data-operations tooling and automation that kept platform data and services reliable at scale with **99.9% uptime**.
Delivered features independently from requirements through deployment while collaborating asynchronously with remote stakeholders.
Improved backend performance by **25%** through query optimization and caching; implemented JWT auth and Stripe subscriptions for production systems.
